confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a July 2026 window from general knowledge; no live listings were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by area, season and booking date. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker and were set relative to the beer anchor (about 2x and 1.9x) due to limited direct price knowledge. Restaurant figures approximate typical bills with usual service charge and tax.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Southeast Asian capitals with mixed hawker and mid-range dining: below Singapore overall and broadly in line with Bangkok for mid-range dining. Alcohol is relatively expensive given Malaysian excise and import duties, so drink anchors are set high relative to food.
